latest.title: Unlocking AWS: The Secrets of Quantum Computing and AGI
latest.description: Discover under-the-radar AWS tools and advanced chipsets designed to build, scale, and optimize next-generation quantum algorithms and frontier AI models.

latest.title: How to Manage IAM in AWS: A Complete Guide to Users, Roles, Policies, and Permissions
latest.description: Learn how to manage AWS IAM users, roles, policies, and permissions to secure cloud resources and implement best practices for access control.

latest.title: Foundation Models: The Core of Generative AI
latest.description: Learn what Foundation Models are, how they work, their real-world applications, and how Amazon Bedrock helps developers build generative AI applications.

latest.title: The Cloud Undo Button: Designing AWS Systems That Can Recover From Their Own Mistakes
latest.description: What if every critical cloud operation had a recovery strategy before execution? Explore how to design reversible AWS workflows using infrastructure rollback, versioning, backups, event tracking, and automated recovery mechanisms to reduce the impact of production failures.

latest.title: Building CloudPulse: My Hands-On Journey into AWS Cloud Monitoring
latest.description: Exploring AWS through CloudPulse, a practical cloud monitoring project. Discover how AWS services, application monitoring, cloud architecture, and cost-conscious deployment come together in a real-world learning experience.

latest.title: Meet RavMem: Persistent Memory for AI Agent Teams
latest.description: AI coding agents are good at the task in front of them and bad at remembering anything else.

latest.title: Stopped Your EC2 Instance? Why AWS Charges May Continue
latest.description: Stopping an Amazon EC2 instance doesn't necessarily stop all AWS costs. Discover how EBS volumes, snapshots, and public IPv4 addresses can continue generating charges, and learn how to manage unused resources effectively.

latest.title: Auto-Compressing Uploaded Images on AWS S3 with Lambda (Zero Server Management)
latest.description: Instead of resizing images inside your main backend API—which blocks threads and eats up memory—you can offload the whole process to an event-driven workflow using Amazon S3 and AWS Lambda

latest.title: Detecting Problems Before They Become Emergencies | Part 3
latest.description: Can AI detect urban problems before they escalate? Explore anomaly detection, time-series analysis, Python, and Amazon SageMaker AI to identify unusual patterns in smart-city sensor data and support early warnings.

latest.title: Vote on a wish each week for four consecutive weeks.
latest.description: In modern cloud environments, application traffic is never constant. Sometimes an application receives hundreds of requests, while during peak hours, that number can increase to thousands or even millions.

trending.title: Once Upon Agentic AI (Part 1): Create your own agent and forge its tools with Strands Agents
trending.description: Once upon a time, there was a world built not of stone and steel, but of code. In this realm, every function was an incantation, every bug a curse, every deployment a battle.

trending.title: Cómo OverTheWire: Bandit Transforma tu Habilidad en Linux de "Copy-Paster" a SRE Pro
trending.description: Si llevas un tiempo en el mundo del desarrollo de software, DevOps o SRE, probablemente conozcas la sensación: necesitas analizar un archivo de log masivo en producción, buscar un patrón de texto específico o diagnosticar una falla de conexión en red, y terminas buscando en Google el comando exacto o pidiéndole a un modelo de IA que te redacte el script.

trending.title: When "Not Found" Doesn't Mean "Never Happened"
trending.description: A lease expiry proves only that a worker stopped reporting. In five real-clock runs, a naive reconciler wrote the same ticket twice, and a late commit survived the lookup.

trending.title: Kiro usage analytics on your own Grafana, with Docker Compose, OpenTelemetry and Prometheus
trending.description: Self-host Kiro’s daily OpenTelemetry usage export with Docker Compose: Caddy TLS, a collector that hashes user IDs, Prometheus and a Grafana dashboard that flags missing days. Includes a simulator, so you can test before the first real export.

trending.title: Detecting Flaky Tests and Finding Their Root Causes with Strands Agents and Gemini
trending.description: Flaky tests pass and fail on the same code, eroding trust in your pipeline and hiding real failures. In this article, I show how I built an open-source detector in Python that parses JUnit reports, scores each test per commit, and ranks the flakiest ones. Then I add an AI agent built with Strands Agents and Gemini that reads the reports and infers the root causes. Includes code, GitHub Actions integration, and tips on when to run it.

trending.title: The AI Said This Athena Query Was Cheaper. I Made It Prove It.
trending.description: I let Amazon Bedrock propose a lower-scan Athena query, then made deterministic checks across Athena, EMR Serverless, Redshift Serverless, and Glue Data Quality decide whether it was safe. The result cut measured scan bytes by 78.3%—and still ran slightly slower.

trending.title: From Niche Market to Subset of IT: How Broadcast Is Reinventing Itself
trending.description: Broadcast is no longer a niche. It’s becoming a demanding subset of IT. In this recap of my FKTG Fachtagung 2026 talk, I look at four transformations running at once (SDI to IP, hardware to software, on-prem to cloud, and cost), why the cost shift hits administration before engineering, how lifecycles and processes change, and which roles manufacturers, integrators and broadcasters play now. Plus: what AWS New Voices taught me about speaking.

trending.description: My impressions from the AWS Community Day Malta 2026

trending.title: Scoped or Spoofed: What a Missing OIDC Condition Really Costs You in AWS
trending.description: This article explores how overly permissive GitHub Actions OIDC trust policies can expose AWS environments to unauthorized access, privilege escalation, and cross-account persistence. Through a hands-on attack scenario, it explains the attack chain and practical steps to strengthen IAM trust policies, enforce least privilege, and eliminate unauthorized access paths.

trending.title: Serendipity Engine: Building a Grounded "Constructive Surprise" Discovery App on AWS with the Events API, Amazon Bedrock, and Serverless Services
trending.description: A technical write-up for the AWS re:Invent Event Catalog API Hackathon, built spec-first with Kiro.
